page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with marginal notes in the left margin (the number 1467. beside a line of text, and a note-free text column). Running head at the top, page number at the top, catchword at the foot right.
page.notes: Transcription was not completed. The page is a 16th/17th-century Latin text with Greek phrases at the start of the first line and in the margin, and the text includes many ligatures and abbreviations (q;, &, ꝑ-type forms) that I could not reliably read in full. The first line opens with Greek (ἀδίκημα-type word, presumed "ἀδικούμενοι"); the remaining text is roughly 40 lines of Latin on the page, of which I could not verify the wording. Catchword "citaf-" is at the foot right. Several Greek words, the Latin on the page (including the sentence beginning "Si tunc iustitia in te reddita fuisset") and the margin note at 1467 need a fresh, higher-resolution scan for accurate transcription. Marked as incomplete rather than guessed.
